notities.nl: Control en Screen hebben nu duidelijke knoppen met pictogrammen en uitleg. Op de downloadpagina zie je echte foto’s van de ZAPPER met open en gesloten behuizing.
notities.en: Control and Screen now have clear buttons with icons and descriptions. The download page shows real photos of the ZAPPER with its case open and closed.

notities.nl: Eigen npub en Andere npub volgen zijn nu afzonderlijk aan of uit te zetten. Volgen staat standaard uit en vraagt alleen een openbare npub. Zaps op profiel, berichten en reacties tellen mee. Nieuwe instellingen bovenaan, bijgewerkte Control en handleiding.
notities.en: Own npub and Follow another npub now have independent on/off switches. Following defaults off and needs only a public npub. Profile, post and reply zaps count. Clearer settings, updated Control and manual.

notities.nl: Nieuw voor speciale momenten: Frysk folksliet (volledig), één compleet couplet met het herhaalde refrein, ongeveer 33 seconden. Kies het in Jukebox of als groepsfeestdeuntje. Werk alle deelnemende zoemers bij. De korte De âlde Friezen blijft de standaard; Stop onderbreekt direct.
notities.en: New for special occasions: Frysk folksliet (volledig), the complete melody of one verse and the repeated refrain, about 33 seconds. Select it in Jukebox or as the group-party tune. Update all participating buzzers. The short De âlde Friezen remains the default; Stop interrupts immediately.

notities.nl: Zapper Screen heeft nu zichtbare NL- en EN-knoppen. Wissel direct tussen Nederlands en Engels; je keuze blijft in deze browser bewaard. De titel blijft op telefoons vrij van de hoekknoppen. Inclusief de USB-flasherreparatie voor nieuwe lampen.
notities.en: Zapper Screen now has visible NL and EN buttons. Switch instantly between Dutch and English; this browser remembers your choice. On phones, the heading stays clear of the corner controls. Includes the USB flasher fix for new lamps.

notities.nl: Groepsfeest werkt met 2 tot 32 lampen en controleert ontvanger, tijd, herhaling en nachtrust. Control toont bereikbaarheid, gedeelde instellingen en resultaten per lamp; Jukebox meldt geaccepteerd, overgeslagen of mislukt. Duidelijkere mobiele menu’s en USB-herstel met behoud van identiteit. Actuele handleiding en voorbeelden.
notities.en: Group party supports 2 to 32 lamps with recipient, freshness, replay and quiet-hours checks. Control shows reachability, shared settings and per-lamp results; Jukebox distinguishes accepted, skipped and failed actions. Clearer mobile menus and USB recovery that preserves identity. Updated manual and examples.

notities.nl:
• Zapper Control zit in elke lamp op /control: beheer meerdere lampen vanuit je browser, zonder installatie.
• Volg de eigen lamp, maximaal vier andere accounts of alle zaps; de lampsleutel blijft behouden. Ongeldige invoer laat de instellingen intact.
• Zapper Screen staat op /screen; de oude adressen blijven werken.
• USB-flasher: één keer verbinden, daarna Firmware en Wifi als aparte tegels. Wifi zoeken werkt ook in setupstand en bij een onbereikbaar opgeslagen netwerk.
• Betrouwbaardere USB-opdrachten en herstel na opnieuw aansluiten van dezelfde lamp. Handleiding en website bijgewerkt.
notities.en:
• Zapper Control lives in every lamp at /control: manage several lamps in your browser, with nothing to install.
• Follow the lamp itself, up to four other accounts or every zap, while keeping the lamp key. Invalid input leaves settings unchanged.
• Zapper Screen lives at /screen; old addresses still work.
• USB flasher: connect once, then use separate Firmware and Wi-Fi tiles. Network scanning works in setup mode and when the saved network is unreachable.
• More reliable USB requests and recovery after reconnecting the same lamp. Manual and website updated.

notities.nl:
• De downloadpagina staat nu op GitHub Pages: https://jaccoelektro.github.io/zapper-updates/ (gratis en altijd de nieuwste). De QR Naar je telefoon en Zapper control wijzen daarheen.
• Nieuwe Zapper flashen via USB, de gids met schermafdrukken, en Zapper control met nostr-instellingen.
notities.en: • The download page moved to GitHub Pages: https://jaccoelektro.github.io/zapper-updates/ (free, always the newest, no build credits). The QR "To your phone", Zapper control's download and flash buttons, the manual and the README point there.

notities.nl:
• Flash a new board over USB straight from the download page (Chrome or Edge on a computer): one button per board, always with the newest firmware. Zapper control 2.5 has a button for it.
• A brand new board no longer logs a storage error at its first start.

notities.nl:
• The Zapper screen (/scherm): a clean page for a TV or tablet with every lamp, lighting up live, its nostr picture and name, a QR to zap it, its lightning address, zaps, sats, goal and latest zap, and the block height. No settings on it; back and full screen in the corners.
• Control a lamp by nostr DM from your own npub (old NIP-04 and private NIP-17 DMs): party, zap, on, off, auto, stop, find. Signature checked, once per message, at most two minutes old.
• All Zappers: top zappers with their nostr pictures, sats per day for the last 30 days, the block height, a QR per lamp, a simple view, NIP-05 for all lamps on your own domain (with nostr.json), and a new block celebration and the DM owner in the bulk settings.
• Settings, Carry settings over: one tap to copy them to your other Zappers.
• The GitHub link in the lamp points to the public update channel.

notities.nl:
• Open a lamp from All Zappers and you are in, already logged in, with every setting of that lamp: relays, nostr key, wallet, goal, alerts and the rest. The session travels after the # of the link, so it never goes over the network, and a lamp from 1.10 turns it into its own cookie.
• All Zappers shows the totals of all your lamps (zaps, sats, biggest zap) and a live feed of the latest zaps on every lamp: who, how many sats, the message, and to which lamp. A zap refreshes it within seconds.
• Each lamp shows its zaps, sats, relays and Wi-Fi signal, and its npub (open it on njump, or copy it).
• "How does this work?" explains the page in five lines for someone new to zaps.
• A lamp now reads its session cookies by their exact names, so an expired one no longer hides a valid one.

notities.nl: • The default password is Bitcoin21 again, as before 1.9: leave it empty at setup and that is the password; change it after the first login under Settings, and the overview reminds you until you do. The Bluetooth PIN is the lamp password, so Bitcoin21 by default. All Zappers and Zapper control try it on lamps that still have it.

notities.nl:
• All Zappers: every lamp now manages the other ZAPPERs on your network, with nothing to install. Open any lamp in your browser, on a phone or a computer, and tap All Zappers: each lamp with its own picture that follows the real one, Automatic, Always on and Always off, and the tunes for a zap and a celebration.
• Pick several lamps to act on them together: update to the newest firmware, test zap, celebration, find me, lamp mode, restart, tunes, common settings, Wi-Fi, copy this lamp's settings, one backup file, and a QR code that puts them under My Zappers in the phone app.
• No default password any more. You choose one of at least 8 characters when you set the lamp up; a lamp set up over Bluetooth asks for one on the first visit. Until it has one, its Bluetooth PIN is its own name. A lamp that still has the old factory password says so on its overview.
